title: First Spring (Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm female vocal 104bpm brushed drums gentle storytelling intimate garden spring Perth Australia seasons birds
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
September in Perth and the jacaranda's thinking about it
It hasn't committed yet but the purple is without doubt
Coming — and the garden's been in winter patience long enough
The first spring says that it was worth the quiet rough

[Pre-Chorus]
You don't know it was hard until the first spring comes
And then you know — because the first spring comes

[Chorus]
First spring, first spring
After all the winter's work you can't yet see
First spring, first spring
Coming up through the ground to meet the morning tea
First spring knows where it's been — under the soil, in the root
First spring knows where it's going — up into the light and fruit
The gardens still growing

[Verse 2]
The warbler came back this morning to the old spot in the peppercorn tree
And sat there and announced that the season's changed — at least to me
September says the wattlebird is back in the grevillea bush
And the first spring knows that that's the signal and the rush

[Bridge]
In Zimbabwe the first rains were the signal and the season
Here in Perth the first rains are the same although the reason
Is different — the dry is different and the season is reversed
But the feeling of the first sign of new life isn't cursed
By geography — it's the same wherever you have roots

[Outro]
First spring knows the way up… always has…
The gardens still growing
